name: Riesling
message: 「It is true that my favorite food is fried rice vermicelli.」

name: Riesling
message: 「That being said, and it may be presumptuous of me to say so, what do you think about giving fried rice vermicelli as a birthday present?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I cannot help but feel that it is somewhat lacking in appropriateness.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Of course. Once I return home today, I will gladly eat every last bite by myself.」
